founder.introduction: My journey began over 25 years ago with a passion for technology, growing into a career in enterprise data architecture, cloud innovation, and digital transformation. Along the way, I discovered that technology's true value lies in making people's lives better. This belief inspired me to found SIVA Techno Mart, with a vision to simplify everyday life through AI, empower families, transform learning, and turn ideas into opportunities. As a lifelong learner, educator, and mentor, I believe knowledge grows when shared and innovation thrives when everyone has the opportunity to learn. My mission is simple: Transform experience into innovation, innovation into opportunity, and opportunity into a better future for everyone.

mission: Empowering everyday professionals to become technology creators.
